verdict.rationale: LangSmith is an API-bearing SaaS platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence only says traces can be handled 'via the UI or API' and that SDKs exist. Nothing documents an interactive API explorer with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
